fm_reference: FM24 Match Day: live match engine, commentary, touchline instructions

history.gap: No visual battle presentation in the live view - text cards + ticker only; add an animated arena centerpiece synced to engine events.

Prior gap closed: the live view now has an animated arena stage (type-ringed medallions with HP arcs, lunges, projectiles, floating damage numbers, faint/switch/item animations) synced to the event stream. Manual play verified end-to-end via UI button presses: move, switch and item each executed and confirmed in the engine log. Both mandatory failing conditions pass.

Both mandatory conditions verified live by an independent driver (artifacts/match/drive1): turn 1 offered 4 moves + 5 switches + item use simultaneously; a move, a switch and an X Attack were each executed through the real action-bar buttons/popup (items spent 0->1, bag x3->x2, engine + commentary + post-match report all agree), and the animated stage rendered lunges/projectiles/switch slides/item flourishes mid-battle. Result flowed to inbox/table/next-fixture. Secondary polish defect to fix: the commentary column overflows the right viewport edge and clips text mid-word whenever the action bar is hidden during replay (shots 03/05/06/07); also the top-bar cash figure lags the items-screen club balance after in-session purchases (shell-side).
